title: The Telangana Prevention of Begging Act, 1977.
full_text: The Telangana Prevention of Begging Act, 1977. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197712 Act Number: 12 Enactment Date: 1977-04-30 Act Year: 1977 Short Title: The Telangana Prevention of Begging Act, 1977. Long Title: An Act to consolidate and amend the law providing for the prevention of begging for the detention, training and employment of beggars and their dependents in certified institutions and for the custody, trial and punishment of beggar offenders in the State of Telangana.
